answer: The admission bond is time locked for 19 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are published in kernel, expire in atlas, and willow lists each expiry. An adversary running 81 aliases thus needs 152 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4538 identities would post 2876 proofs and burn roughly 42 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
